coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured AI blog redirects to Microsoft Source AI. Topic-page links were collected, but reliable publication dates were not fully paired with titles, and the configured feed returned HTTP 410. A separate Source AI topic feed returned 10 entries dated June 2 through September 10, outside the discovery window. That alternative feed does not replace the configured entry point. Reading individual selected articles is separate from complete collection coverage; these gaps do not establish an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The old GitHub blog has a latest visible date of September 23, 2025. Static data for the current research page includes 60 entries, with the latest dated December 23, 2025; separate advancement and news lists end in September and April 2025. Retrieval attempts returned no entries, and the rendered research view did not yield a complete, dated October 2026 list. An August 2026 asset-expiry timestamp is not a research publication date. The old blog did not load in the local follow-up, and current research dates remain incompletely verified. This does not establish that there were no new publications.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The official page returned HTTP 200 and two news links without paired titles and publication dates. Research links also led to Qwen page data, but a complete dated list was not established. Links overlapping with Qwen retain their discovery channels rather than being counted as separate news. Access to these entry points does not establish an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The initial response was a small page shell. The rendered site showed Step 5 Preview, Step 3.7 Flash, Step 3.5 Flash, and StepAudio 3, including an open-source countdown, without verifiable absolute publication dates. A countdown is not a completed release and does not justify assigning a release to this issue date.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: Three homepage announcements were dated February 13, March 23, and September 24, 2026, all before the discovery window. Active venues and open-submission links lacked submission timestamps in the homepage record. New papers across individual venues were not exhaustively traversed, so this check cannot establish that the entire platform had no new submissions.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review: Topic-page title links and dated URLs were collected, but they did not establish complete list coverage. The feed returned 10 entries spanning September 28 through October 5 at 15:47:52 UTC, with four in the discovery window. The browser follow-up showed the first 10 newest-to-oldest topic cards, spanning October 5 through September 23; that view is not identical to the feed or a complete archive. Abstract or paywall access is not full-text reading.
